services.name: 2024 Coachmen Freedom Express
services.desc: Whole-family fun is waiting for you in this spacious travel trailer. The kids or your guests will love the private bunkhouse with four bunks, plus a wardrobe with a countertop to keep their things. You will enjoy the front private bedroom with a walk-around queen bed and dual wardrobes, and if you have any other guests, they can sleep on the sofa or U-shaped dinette within the large slide out. The kitchen includes everything needed to prepare meals each day, including a microwave oven, a three burner cooktop, and a double door refrigerator. Drop Off : 3pm // Pick up: 3-7 Nights

services.name: 2024 Coachmen Catalina
services.desc: When you enjoy camping with your own accommodations and space for the whole crew, have us hitch this trailer up and head to the campgrounds! With the exterior awning and slideout, there is plenty of indoor and outdoor space to hang out with your family or friends. When you are out camping everyone loves cooking outside, the cook might like to make a meal using the outdoor camper kitchen. The interior kitchen offers full amenities including a pantry, and everyone can enjoy the angled entertainment center. There are double-size bunks with a ladder for the kids and a walk-around queen for 3-7 Nights

services.name: 2025 Prime Time Avenger
services.desc: Your Northern Michigan adventure starts here! Located in the heart of Indian River, this 2025 Avenger 24Bhsle is the perfect home base for exploring Burt Lake, the Inland Waterway, or any of the beautiful nearby state parks. This clean, modern camper comfortably sleeps up to 6-8 people with a private queen bedroom, double-over-double bunk beds, and a convertible sofa and dinette.
